subject: Concentric wall clock and pocket watch reading 10:10, with curved graphite hatching.
method: Exact SVG clock geometry; concentric form-following graphite hatching and cross-hatching; no raster material.
checks: Verified both bezels, face edges, ticks and centre pins share the exact code origin. Radii 600, 582, 568, 547, 527 and 505 are concentric; no embedded raster material or doubled rim; assertClock passed.
Verified 10:10 on both clocks: hour hand 305 degrees from twelve, five degrees past ten; minute hand 60 degrees. Retained hand silhouettes and lengths meet their centre pins.
Code counts 60 evenly spaced ticks and twelve real Arabic numerals per dial. At 2x verified numeral order and all visible ticks within the 527-radius face, ending at radius 505.
At 2x verified curved graphite strokes and oblique cross-hatching model the rolled bezel, with bowed face hatching; no noise-texture fills, unregistered material, fake glyphs or floating parts.

Inspected final 420 px and 2x paper/cinema previews beside the A-grade circuits plate, including the full pocket watch; normal inversion remains legible, frame span exceeds 60% on both axes and the small hour hand is over 40 px at 420.

Verified transparent margins and file-size ceiling (800px <=90000 B; 1600px <=120000 B); detailed EN/ZH alt/caption match the two clocks and exact hand positions. Displayed cover alt remains the bilingual topic title.
Acceptance 2026-11-09: removed a doubled hatching sector and stroke gaps in bezelHatching that showed as a dark block at 3 o'clock and white speckle.

alt.en: A graphite wall clock and pocket watch with concentric hatched bezels, both reading 10:10; each hour hand is five degrees past ten.
alt.zh: 一只挂钟和一只怀表的石墨画，表圈同心并以排线塑形，两只钟表都显示十点十分；时针均走过十的位置五度。

caption.en: Both clocks read 10:10. The minute hand points to two; the hour hand has moved one sixth of the way from ten to eleven.
caption.zh: 两只钟表都显示十点十分。分针指向二；时针从十朝十一走过六分之一格。

subject: Code: four marked magnets, summed point-pole field, seeded filings.
method: Code: four marked magnets, summed point-pole field, seeded filings.
checks: Exactly four bar magnets: top facing N–S, bottom facing N–N; each bar has opposite poles; assertFilings passed.
Real N/S glyphs identify the poles independently of shade in both themes; no illumination meaning is encoded by lightness.
Filings cross the unlike-pole gap and turn aside around the like-pole cancellation region.
Inspected the final raster at 2× zoom: complete intended components, no fake writing or stray old arrow fragments.
Inspected 420 px paper and cinema simulations; composition spans at least 60% in both dimensions and the main specimens/components remain readable.

subject: Code: SVG isolation/layout of retained graphite specimens; all arrows regenerated.
method: Code: SVG isolation/layout of retained graphite specimens; all arrows regenerated.
checks: Exactly three rows and 11 stages: mosquito four, butterfly four, grasshopper three; assertCycles passed.
All eleven links have one arrowhead: forward stage order plus one return from adult to eggs per row; there is no reverse nymph/adult arrow.
Inspected complete antennae, wings and legs; disconnected fragments of the original arrows and neighbouring specimens removed by component isolation.
Inspected the final raster at 2× zoom: complete intended components, no fake writing or stray old arrow fragments.
Inspected 420 px paper and cinema simulations; composition spans at least 60% in both dimensions and the main specimens/components remain readable.

subject: Original graphite local AI edits through code masks; code rear-plane shading; original kinematic assertions.
method: Original graphite local AI edits through code masks; code rear-plane shading; original kinematic assertions.
checks: Counted one beam, one parallelogram linkage, one rear radius rod, two fixed supports and one downward piston rod; original projection and attachment topology retained.
Checked the radius rod passes behind the front outer link with occlusion and recessed shading; no added pivot at the crossing.
Checked diagonal hatching on both fixed supports and a visibly bolder, cylindrically shaded piston rod; assertMotion and the measured original/edit piston-width assertion passed.

Visually inspected final 420 px paper and cinema simulations beside the retained A-grade series/parallel plate, and native 2× paper/cinema detail crops; no fake writing, detached parts or added noise fills.
Checked positive transparent margins and at least 60% frame span in both dimensions; key mechanism members remain legible at 420 px.

alt.en: Watt’s parallel motion: a beam on a hatched fixed support, front parallelogram links, a radius rod passing behind the outer link to a second fixed support, and one bold downward piston rod.
alt.zh: 瓦特平行运动机构：横梁由带排线的固定支座支撑，前方为平行四边形连杆，摇杆从外侧连杆后面穿过、连到另一固定支座，一根粗活塞杆向下伸出。

caption.en: The beam, parallelogram and radius rod guide the piston rod along a nearly straight path.
caption.zh: 横梁、平行四边形连杆和摇杆共同引导活塞杆沿近似直线路径运动。

subject: Original graphite local AI cavern edit, scaled 0.8 about the floor centre at acceptance for thick rock cover, laid in through a feathered horseshoe matte; section assertions.
method: Original graphite local AI cavern edit, scaled 0.8 about the floor centre at acceptance for thick rock cover, laid in through a feathered horseshoe matte; section assertions.
checks: Checked the retained original fill, soft seabed/clay, six drains, rock revetment and sea; the edit mask is confined to the cavern region in the rock.
Checked one broad horseshoe cavern: arched roof, nearly vertical lower walls and a flat floor; entirely below the clay/rock boundary, with no circular pipe ring.
Checked the cavern is wider than twice its height, sits under at least 60 px of rock below the clay, and exceeds 40 px width and height at 420 px; assertSection passed.
Inspected rock rim, curved interior hatching and the local patch boundary at 2× in both themes; retained original geological graphite drawing remains continuous.

Visually inspected final 420 px paper and cinema simulations beside the retained A-grade series/parallel plate, and native 2× paper/cinema detail crops; no fake writing, detached parts or added noise fills.

alt.en: Graphite section of reclaimed fill, six drains through soft seabed, a rock seawall and the sea; a broad horseshoe-shaped cavern with a flat floor lies entirely in the rock below.
alt.zh: 填海剖面的石墨图：填土下方有六根穿过软海床的排水管，岸边为石堤与海水；下方岩层中有一座拱顶、直壁、平底的宽阔马蹄形岩洞。

caption.en: Reclaimed fill lies above the soft seabed; the large arched cavern is excavated in the deeper rock. This is a conceptual section.
caption.zh: 填土位于软海床上方；宽阔的拱顶岩洞开挖在更深的岩层里。这是一幅概念剖面图。

subject: Five-stage two-row power chain with three end-on cable sections below soil.
method: Retained four power-edit.png crops; precise SVG underground section and arrows; layered pencil hatching.
checks: Verified the four retained graphite groups use exactly the round-two source crops and placements; recovered power-edit.png is byte-identical to commit 208d2711.

Counted five stages and four arrows at 420 px: generation to tower, down to substation, left to underground cables, left to homes. Shafts are 4.5 px and heads 20 px in the master; assertPowerChain passed.
At 2x counted exactly three round cable sections on a tray supported by both tunnel walls, each with seven solid wire ends. No pipe lengths, flanges, clamps or back-wall projection.
At 2x verified a continuous surface line above hatched soil and a concrete arch, with at least 50 master pixels of soil above the arch crown; no floating components or fake writing.

Inspected final 420 px and 2x paper/cinema comparisons beside the A-grade circuits plate: fine layered hatching, clear cable sections, all five stage groups over 40 px, frame span over 60% on both axes.
Verified final WebP is 1200x900 with transparent margins and at most 120000 bytes; EN/ZH alt and caption match the new two-row, end-on composition.
Acceptance 2026-11-09: soil re-hatched lighter with outlined stones, concrete lining darker, cable cast shadows and sheath highlights, so soil and lining separate in both themes.

alt.en: Graphite power-supply chain in two rows. Arrows lead from a three-chimney power station to a transmission tower, then down to two substation transformers, left to an arched tunnel cross-section beneath a ground line and hatched soil, and left again to apartment blocks. Three round cable cross-sections with solid wire ends rest on a wall-supported tray inside the tunnel.
alt.zh: 分两行排列的石墨电力供应链图。箭头从有三根烟囱的发电厂指向输电铁塔，再向下指向变电站的两台变压器，接着向左指向地面线和排线土层下的拱形隧道横截面，最后向左指向住宅楼。隧道中，三个露出实心导线端面的圆形电缆截面放在由隧道壁支撑的托架上。

caption.en: Follow the arrows: power station, overhead transmission, substation, underground cables, homes. The tunnel is cut across the cables, showing their round sections below the soil.
caption.zh: 沿箭头依次看：发电厂、架空输电线、变电站、地下电缆、住宅。隧道沿垂直电缆的方向剖开，露出土层下电缆的圆形截面。
